prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1409; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client has sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is pursuing a claim for compensation.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly. If your insured is represented by counsel or has been referred to you by a different party, please let us know immediately so we can coordinate accordingly.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under all policies that may apply to the at-fault driver and the vehicle involved, including any umbrella or excess coverage. Please provide written confirmation of those limits as soon as possible.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss, including the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data and telematics, repair estimates, and any dash camera or surveillance footage. Please ensure that no evidence is altered, discarded, or repaired without adequate notice to our office.
